has jurisdiction of the subject matter
and parties.

Reason
Relief Should
Be Granted: 
The drilling
of the horizontal
well
as a multiunit
horizontal
well will prevent both economic
waste and a waste of hydrocarbons. 
It is less
expensive
to drill a longer lateral in a single horizontal
well then to drill two laterals in two
separate
horizontal
wells. In addition, being permitted
to complete
and produce
the lateral
across the section line allows for the production
of hydrocarbons
from a larger portion of

well.
